sentences.text: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 -LRB- also released as The Amazing Spider-Man 2 : Rise of Electro in some markets -RRB- is a 2014 American superhero film featuring the Marvel Comics character Spider-Man .	The Amazing Spider-Man	The Amazing Spider-Man (2012 film)	superhero film	superhero film	Marvel Comics	Marvel Comics	Spider-Man	Spider-Man
The film was directed by Marc Webb and was produced by Avi Arad and Matt Tolmach .	Marc Webb	Marc Webb	Avi Arad	Avi Arad

It is the fifth theatrical Spider-Man film produced by Columbia Pictures and Marvel Entertainment , and is the sequel to The Amazing Spider-Man -LRB- 2012 -RRB- ; it is also the final film in the Amazing Spider-Man franchise .	The Amazing Spider-Man	The Amazing Spider-Man (2012 film)	Marvel Entertainment	Marvel Entertainment	Columbia Pictures	Columbia Pictures	Spider-Man	Spider-Man
The studio hired James Vanderbilt to write the screenplay and Alex Kurtzman and Roberto Orci to rewrite it .	Alex Kurtzman	Alex Kurtzman	Roberto Orci	Roberto Orci	James Vanderbilt	James Vanderbilt

The film stars Andrew Garfield as Peter Parker / Spider-Man , Emma Stone as Gwen Stacy , Dane DeHaan as Green Goblin / Harry Osborn , Campbell Scott and Embeth Davidtz as Peter 's parents , and Sally Field as Aunt May , with the addition of a new cast including Paul Giamatti as Rhino / Aleksei Sytsevich and Jamie Foxx as Electro / Max Dillon . DeHaan , Giamatti , Jones , and Cooper were cast between December 2012 and February 2013 .
Filming took place in New York City from February to June 2013 .	New York City	New York City
The film was released in 2D , 3D , and IMAX 3D on May 2 , 2014 , in the United States with two international premieres being held between March 31 & April 10 , 2014 .	3D	3D film	IMAX 3D	IMAX

The film received mixed reviews , and although it grossed $ 709 million worldwide and became the ninth-highest-grossing film of 2014 , it was the lowest-grossing film in the series .	ninth-highest-grossing film of 2014	2014 in film
However , the film was declared a `` hit '' in the overseas markets with high openings and a wide cinematic release .

The film subsequently won awards for its music composition and acting , notably one Nickelodeon Kids ' Choice Award and two ASCAP Awards .	ASCAP Awards	American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers

The Amazing Spider-Man 2 was originally envisioned as the beginning of a shared fictional universe , which would have continued with two sequels and several spin-off films .	The Amazing Spider-Man	The Amazing Spider-Man (2012 film)	Spider-Man	Spider-Man
